title: General Stubblebine recruits Buchanan into the Fort Meade remote viewing unit
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of General Stubblebine recruits Buchanan into the Fort Meade remote viewing unit, about 1980s at Fort Meade, Maryland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, he took me out to Fort me and um
You know, he turned to me and got up in my face and said, "Did you kill my computers with your mind?"
tellings.difference: Adds Stubblebine's search for psychokinesis talent, the 'Did you kill my computers with your mind?' confrontation and a mention of The Men Who Stare at Goats.
tellings.link_reason: Buchanan's account of Stubblebine recruiting him into the unit, matching the Stubblebine recruitment story.
